## API Surface
### Endpoints
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | /api/auth/callback/credentials | Auth.js credentials sign-in (served by /api/auth/[...nextauth]). Called ONLY through signIn('credentials', { email, password, redirect: false }) from next-auth/react, which fetches the CSRF token itself. Runs authorizeCredentials: IP rate limit (10 / 5 min), user lookup, bcrypt or DUMMY_HASH compare, status and lock checks, lockout counter, audit. Used by the existing /login (verify only), C4 post-invite sign-in, and the C9 e2e signInAs helper. |
| GET | /api/auth/csrf | Auth.js CSRF token (served by /api/auth/[...nextauth]). Called implicitly by signIn()/signOut(). C9 signs in through the UI, so no test calls it directly. |
| POST | /api/auth/signout | Auth.js sign-out (served by /api/auth/[...nextauth]). Called only through signOut({ redirectTo: '/login' }) from the shell user menu (C7). Clears the session cookie. |
| POST | /api/auth/forgot-password | Request a password reset link (C1 /forgot-password). Always returns the same 200 body whether or not the account exists (no enumeration). IP limit 10/h → 429; per-email limit 3/h is SILENT (still 200, no token). For an ACTIVE, non-archived user: createToken(PASSWORD_RESET, 60 min), sendAuthEmail('password-reset') → EmailOutbox, audit auth.password.reset_requested. UI (C1): 2xx → success Alert with data.message; 429 → error Alert 'Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.' (IP-scoped, so it reveals nothing about the account). |
| POST | /api/auth/reset-password | Set a new password from a reset link (C2 page → C4 TokenPasswordForm mode=reset). verifyToken(PASSWORD_RESET) → policy → bcrypt 12 → transaction(consume token, set hash, passwordChangedAt=now, failedLoginCount=0, lockedUntil=null) → audit auth.password.reset. Success → router.replace('/login?reset=1'). 410 → C4 switches to the invalid-link Alert. Other sessions are revoked within 5 min through the passwordChangedAt recheck. |
| POST | /api/auth/accept-invite | Activate an invited account (C3 page → C4 TokenPasswordForm mode=invite). verifyToken(INVITE) → policy → bcrypt 12 → transaction(consume token, set hash, status=ACTIVE, passwordChangedAt=now) → audit auth.invite.accepted. Does NOT create a session: C4 then calls signIn('credentials', { email, password, redirect: false }) and router.replace('/dashboard'). On 410 C4 renders the FR-13 copy ('This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask the school office to send a new one.'), not the service message. |
| POST | /api/account/password | Signed-in password change (C5 /account/security). requireUser → changePasswordSchema → bcrypt compare current → policy → update hash + passwordChangedAt → audit auth.password.changed → unstable_update({ reauth: true }) re-issues THIS session so only other sessions are revoked (within 5 min). Success → useToast 'Password updated', form reset, router.refresh(). |
